d: Hall in the palace of Adolfo that puts to several apartments; in front of large door, from which you can see the gardens of the court; laterally large busts of bronze. Chorus of Gardeners, and Gardeners who are decorating the room with garlands, festoons, and flower pots; then Tollo.
Adolph followed by Ermanno, and Guards.
Ermanno and Richard.
Floresca, then Tollo, and choir of Gardeners.
Ermanno, and said.
Federico, and sayings.
Tollo, Federico.
Adolfo, Floresca, Ermanno with great Follow, and Chorus.
Richard, and sayings.

Large Countryside. At the bottom of the scene rises a great steep cliff that is advancing on the Danube, which flows into the prospect. On one side a large tree, and a remnant of ruins, on the other a hut. It is evening. They descend from cliffs the armed Gardeners, Tollo leads them.
Tollo, Anna.
Federico only from the cliff.
Tollo with follow of Montanari comes out of the hut, and said aside.
As Tollo goes away to call the Companions he goes out Floresca with Friends disguised as soldiers: she is also in a military dress.
Adolfo, and Riccardo with Séguito, then Tollo.
Adolfo, indi Floresca.
Riccardo, and Federico in the middle of the Soldiers, and sayings.
Tollo, Anna.

The interior of Anna's house: the front door, and two large open windows show the countryside. Both the large exit and the side doors that put to other rooms are surrounded by the Sentinels. Riccardo, then Anna, then Tollo.
Floresca held by Adolfo, and sayings.
Ermanno hasty and agitated, and sayings.
Tollo, Anna, Floresca, in the choir of soldiers, and gardeners.
Very pleasant countryside: at the bottom a row of trees interwoven with flower garlands. Great crowd of Villani, and Soldiers. All the characters.
